lyrics:
Out of our darkness. 0 Jesus Christ,
We call to You before day starts.
Let Your light shine on us to-day.
Remain with us till shadows fall.

1. 0 rising Sun, resplendence of the Father,
Jesus Christ, we sing to you.
The way of life that leads us to the Kingdom,
With one heart we sing your praise.

2. 0 Paschal Lamb, Good Shepherd of your people...
Our saving rock, the fountain of all graces...

3. 0 Son of God, abode of highest glory...
The Royal Spouse, Redeemer of the nations....
